create_MockAlgorithm: create a MockAlgorithm instance with a list of in-graph environments for RL testing
run_MockAlgorithm_begin_episode: run begin_episode on MockAlgorithm to start an episode and return an empty summary
run_MockAlgorithm_perform: run perform on MockAlgorithm to generate random actions within the environment action space bounds
run_MockAlgorithm_experience: run experience on MockAlgorithm to process agent transitions and return an empty summary
run_MockAlgorithm_end_episode: run end_episode on MockAlgorithm to conclude an episode and return an empty summary
